title: Habitual Shoplifter Steals $700 In Candles Then Acts Clueless After Trying To Run
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On January 15th, 2023. Officers were called to a Bath & Body Works in regards a pregnant habitual shoplifter who would come into the store and steal candles along with other items. It was aid she stole 18 candles which equated to $700 in value. Police then located her in a different store, however she was acting very clueless and then took off running. When Officers interviewed her in the car, she didn’t seem to know what they were talking about regarding the thefts. She also had a warrant from previous thefts. This is the body-cam footage of the events that followed.
